name: EPIC 206226228
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.4 solar radii and 1.32 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,010 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.32 solar masses and 7.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,934 K at its surface.
